developer_reply: dubbii is free to download and includes some free features, including one free task. Depending on which task you choose, you'll also have access to a number of linked videos, such as Tidy Timers and Messy Modes, as well as our reminders/nudge feature. Subscriptions help us create new content, run Lives and continue improving the app. Team dubbii
